annotations.annotation_text: The Letter motif "hen" on page 119 ("The Letter from the Midden"): ALP's mysterious document — scratched from the midden by Biddy Doran the Hen — represents the genesis of all writing within Biddy Doran the Hen scratching up the mysterious letter from the dump, the Book of Kells as model for textual exegesis. During this Age of Gods phase, the letter functions simultaneously as archaeological artifact, love note, legal deposition, and the text of Finnegans Wake itself.
